anchors.name: sota_ref_k4
anchors.derivation: S. W. Golomb, L. D. Baumert, "Backtrack Programming," J. ACM 12(4) (1965), 516-524, DOI 10.1145/321296.321300 (confirmed directly by web search during this task's construction). Established S(4)=44 by backtracking search (an explicit sum-free 4-partition of {1,...,44}, plus an exhaustive proof that no partition of {1,...,45} exists). A proven exact value: no valid 4-partition can exceed length 44.

anchors.name: sota_ref_k6
anchors.derivation: H. Fredricksen, M. Sweet, "Symmetric sum-free partitions and lower bounds for Schur numbers," Electron. J. Combin. 7 (2000), #R32. Reports S(6) >= 536. Not proven exact (S(6) remains open); this is the best-known lower-bound witness, confirmed unchanged as of a July 2026 paper (arXiv:2607.15034) that explicitly cites both S(6)=536 and S(7)=1696 as the current, unimproved bounds while improving S(8) and S(13) instead.

anchors.name: sota_ref_k7
anchors.derivation: F. Rowley, "An Improved Lower Bound for S(7) and Some Interesting Templates," arXiv:2107.03560 (2021). Reports S(7) >= 1696, superseding the older S(7) >= 1680 bound (Fredricksen & Sweet, 2000). Not proven exact; confirmed unchanged as of a July 2026 paper (arXiv:2607.15034) that cites 1696 as the current bound.
